'''Third Platoon''' was a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] military unit deployed on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Second Battle of Coruscant]]. [[Red Squad (Third Platoon)|Red Squad]] was assigned to Third Platoon.
